title: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman!?
titleRomaji: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman!?
titleNative: 伝説のヤンキーはエリートサラリーマン!?
synonyms: The Legendary bad boy is an elite office worker!?
synopsis: "Please make me your disciple!!!" Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?! (Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

titleRomaji: Genkai Koe no Skill wa Tenseisha ni Shika Atsukaenai Over Limit Skill Holder

synonyms: Genkaigoe no Skill wa, Tenseisha ni Shika Atsukaenai - Over Limit Skill Holder
Exceeding limits can only be handled by reincarnated people
synopsis: A fantasy adventure about bonds forged with people in a different world. The setting is a world, where everyone has eight skill slots. In these slots people can put skills like “Strengthen arm (1 star rarity)” and “Fire Magic (2 star rarity)” from skill orbs, abilities which prove extremely useful for survival. The total amount of stars your skills have can never exceed your slots. Our protagonist Reiji, worked as a slave that mines skill orbs, until 10 years old. Along with his precious older sister, Larc, they worked gruellingly in the mines until one day, where the chance for rebellion occurred at the mine and Reiji got his hands on a ten-star, a so called "overlimit" skill, also known as World Ruler. Reiji went from a powerless slave to having an ability that surpassed human limits, but in the chaos of the revolt, he was separated from the only person dear to him, his sister Larc. “To regain his bond with her, to make her his true sister”, earnestly thinking so, Reiji’s adventure to distant places starts!

title: Digimon Universe: Appli Monsters
titleNative: デジモンユニバース　アプリモンスターズ
synonyms: Appmon
Digimon Universe: Appli Monsters
synopsis: Everyone in the world uses smartphone apps. But inside them lurks unknown creatures called "Appli Monsters," or "Appmon." The Appmon are AI lifeforms with the ability to think and act, and exist in the boundary between the human world and digital space to allow people and the system to interface and function. But in the vast sea of the internet, the "last boss AI" Leviathan takes control of the Appmon with a virus and begins hacking every system, thus starting to control the human world from the world of the net. The protagonist, Haru Shinkai, is led to acquiring the Appli Drive and uses it to materialize Gacchimon, a search app monster. What is the secret hidden within the Appli Drive? What is the mysterious field that exists between net world where the Appmon exist, and the real world? What is the "App Combine" that can combine two Appmons? What is Leviathan's true goal? (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Zero to Hyaku
synopsis: High school freshman Rei Shizuka isn't blessed with height or strength, but he has a more accurate two-handed shot than anyone else. However, this weapon, which doesn't shine in boys' basketball, is denied every day. Is his weapon invincible to anyone or anything? Just as he begins to lose confidence, an encounter with Misaka Haku, a transfer student from America with a street style, changes his destiny! Stick to your own style! The combination of two-handed shot and street style creates a miracle, and the coolest youth basketball season begins! (Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)
